summary: Iteration 4: Verified real contact form submission (frontend->backend), interviews video slot 0 swap on Home & About, homepage section reorder (fifth-rev-intro > interviews > two-frameworks), and mobile contact flow. Fixed one minor bug in Contact form (missing name attribute on Last Name input) that would have caused 422 backend validation failures.

backend: POST /api/contact with missing required fields -> 422 (correct validation)
frontend: /contact desktop: empty submit blocked by browser validation (no success shown)
/contact desktop: full submission triggers POST /api/contact 200 and shows contact-success (Message Sent!)
/contact mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, form submits successfully
/ Home: interview-video-0 is VIDEO with source /videos/hi-leadership-trust.mp4; video-1 is IFRAME youtube.com/embed/W5EjWImS9Vc; video-2 is VIDEO /videos/times-square.mp4
/ Home DOM order: fifth-rev-intro (top=5288) < interviews (6112) < two-frameworks (6964) — correct
/ Home hero renders 'The future of AI depends on human intelligence.'

critical_code_review_comments: Contact.tsx Last Name input was missing name='last_name' — fixed by testing agent. Would have caused 422 on every real form submit.

server.py: `logger` is used inside submit_contact (lines 82, 101, 121) but defined at line 171 (after include_router). At import time this works because usage is inside a function, but if the contact endpoint is called before the module finishes loading it would NameError. Recommend moving logging.basicConfig/logger definition above route definitions.
server.py CORS_ORIGINS default is '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid CORS combo per spec (browsers reject). Should set explicit origins for prod.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 3 TEST_ contact_submissions rows in Mongo (curl + 2 UI submissions).
